description: This file defines the Response class and related functions for handling and serializing response data, including capturing snapshots, errors, results, and generating markdown reports within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Class for constructing, managing, and serializing response data including errors, results, snapshots, and logs.

methods.name: resolveClientFile
methods.description: Resolves a filename for output, either suggested or generated, and returns its relative and printable link.

methods.name: addTextResult
methods.description: Adds a text string to the response results.

methods.name: addResult
methods.description: Adds a result, either as a file or inline text, depending on configuration.

methods.name: addFileResult
methods.description: Writes data to a file and adds its link to the results.

methods.name: addFileLink
methods.description: Adds a link to a file in the results.

methods.name: registerImageResult
methods.description: Registers an image result for inclusion in the serialized response.

methods.name: setClose
methods.description: Marks the response as indicating closure.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error message to the response.

methods.name: addCode
methods.description: Adds code snippets to the response.

methods.name: setIncludeSnapshot
methods.description: Sets the response to include a snapshot (full or incremental).

methods.name: setIncludeFullSnapshot
methods.description: Sets the response to include a full snapshot, optionally with a filename.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the response into a structured result, including text, images, errors, and snapshots.

methods.name: _build
methods.description: Builds the sections of the response report, including errors, results, code, tabs, snapshots, and logs.
